prMetadata.title: docs: roadmap refresh — Host architecture orientation + stale status fix
prMetadata.body:
Post Phase 0.2 roadmap refresh.

Creates `docs/roadmap.md` as the architecture orientation document encoding the refreshed target: Host authority, replaceable Agent, mediated capabilities, durable scheduling, continuous input semantics, workspace abstraction. The phase sequence stays the same; what changes is what each phase builds toward.

Also fixes stale Phase 0.0 'REOPENED' status text and marks 0.1A/0.2 as CLOSED to match the actual executable state. `phase-0-spec.md` remains the authoritative executable specification; `roadmap.md` is the orientation document that cross-references it.

No code changes, no gate changes.
prMetadata.head: 20219bd384
prMetadata.author: Alajmah
